sentences.en: Last weekend, I made a shelf for my room.
sentences.zh: 上周末，我为我的房间做了一个架子。

sentences.en: I used wood, a hammer, and a few nails.
sentences.zh: 我用了木头、一把锤子和几颗钉子。

sentences.en: First, I measured the wood and made a mark.
sentences.zh: 首先，我量了木头并做了一个记号。

sentences.en: Then I cut it with a knife.
sentences.zh: 然后用刀把它切开。

sentences.en: I put the pieces together.
sentences.zh: 我把零件组装起来。

sentences.en: I fixed them with nails.
sentences.zh: 我用钉子固定。

sentences.en: The shelf was strong enough to hold books.
sentences.zh: 架子够结实，可以放书。

sentences.en: I put it on the wall near my bed.
sentences.zh: 我把它放在我床边的墙上。

sentences.en: Then I put some books and a lamp on it.
sentences.zh: 然后我在上面放了一些书和一盏灯。

sentences.en: It was not as straight as a store shelf.
sentences.zh: 它没有商店的架子那么直。

sentences.en: It was still good.
sentences.zh: 但它仍然不错。

sentences.en: Making things with my own hands gave me pleasure.
sentences.zh: 用自己的双手制作东西让我感到快乐。

sentences.en: My father said I did a good job.
sentences.zh: 我父亲说我做得很好。

sentences.en: Next time, I will make a bigger shelf.
sentences.zh: 下次，我会做一个更大的架子。

sentences.en: I used a screw to make the shelf more stable.
sentences.zh: 我用了一个螺丝让架子更稳固。

sentences.en: A piece of wire was bent to make a hook.
sentences.zh: 一段铁丝被弯成了一个钩子。

sentences.en: The machine had a complex design with many parts.
sentences.zh: 这台机器有一个复杂的结构，有很多部件。

sentences.en: The wheel on the cart was broken.
sentences.zh: 马车上的轮子坏了。

sentences.en: I fixed it.
sentences.zh: 我修好了它。

sentences.en: I used string to tie the pieces together.
sentences.zh: 我用绳子把零件捆在一起。

sentences.en: The process of making a chair takes time and care.
sentences.zh: 做一把椅子的过程需要时间和细心。

sentences.en: I used a pin to mark the point where I would cut.
sentences.zh: 我用一根别针标记了我需要切割的位置。

sentences.en: The material for the new box was strong wood.
sentences.zh: 新盒子的材料是结实的木头。

sentences.en: I used oil to keep the metal from going brown.
sentences.zh: 我用油防止金属变褐。

sentences.en: The engine of the machine had a steam pipe.
sentences.zh: 机器的引擎有一个蒸汽管。

sentences.en: I made an apparatus to keep the wood in place.
sentences.zh: 我做了一个装置来固定木头。

sentences.en: Power from the machine made the work easy.
sentences.zh: 机器的动力让工作变得容易。

sentences.en: I have the skill to produce good work.
sentences.zh: 我有技巧来生产好的作品。

sentences.en: The shelf will probably be strong.
sentences.zh: 架子可能会很结实。

sentences.en: The invention of the wheel changed transport.
sentences.zh: 轮子的发明改变了交通。

sentences.en: The support of the shelf was made of steel.
sentences.zh: 架子的支撑是钢制的。
